how-retirement-ends-a-name.text: Run the seven retirement rows on a real devnet with the packaged runner, using a private shallow temporary directory and the blueprint built from this commit. Two failure controls ship alongside: one makes a refused row valid, the other matches refusals against an impossible marker. Both must fail after executing rows.

limits-and-next-steps.text: The representative here rides under the application policy as a stand-in preserving the single-token shape, and the registry binding is the application hash itself. Custody is created and filled by this runner, but spending it — completion and the withdrawal refusal — arrives as the next step.

what-the-retirement-run-observes.text: Each accepted route proves custody from the chain: the representative is observed at the custody script and the record is observed gone. The refusals are single-defect mutants refused in phase two naming the application validator, including a stored quorum that duplicates one member to bind the distinctness the model demands. The replay is refused by the ledger itself, and the surviving record is unchanged.

what-the-run-observes.text: The accepted row installs the reveal with a fresh commitment and proves preservation and transfer from the chain. Each refusal is a single-defect mutant refused in phase two naming the application validator. Replay and the old controller are refused against the genuine successor, maintenance under the recovered key succeeds, and the state after refusals is unchanged.

what-you-can-do.text: Run the eleven recovery rows on a real devnet with the packaged runner, using a private shallow temporary directory and the blueprint built from this commit. Two failure controls ship alongside: one makes a refused row valid, the other matches refusals against an impossible marker. Both must fail after executing rows.

who-this-is-for.text: This page is for a holder who lost the everyday control key but committed to a next controller in advance, and for a holder — or the registration quorum — who wants to end a name permanently into completion-only custody. You spend the record with the committed address or the quorum alone, and the chain hands over control or ends the name.
